# Set up Open Game Maker 2000

<!-- Generated from apps/site/content/setup.yaml; do not edit this file directly. -->

Work through these steps in order. Replace the literal placeholders `<user>`, `<tailnet-host>`, `<app-origin>`, and `<github-owner>` with values for your host.

## 1. Host an instance

Outcome: A Linux host runs OGM as one normal user through systemd user units.

Time: ~45 min + hand steps

Preconditions: A Debian or Ubuntu x86_64 machine with about 100 GB free.

### 1.1 Prepare a Debian or Ubuntu x86_64 machine with 12 cores and 16 GB RAM suggested, create a normal user, and enable lingering.

Command:

```sh
loginctl enable-linger <user>
```

Writes: `/var/lib/systemd/linger/<user>`

Check: systemctl --user status

### 1.2 Clone OGM at the path expected by the Drive worker.

Command:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/its-everdred/open-game-maker-2000 ~/games/open-game-maker-2000
```

Writes: `~/games/open-game-maker-2000`

Check: git -C ~/games/open-game-maker-2000 log -1

### 1.3 Install Tailscale, grant <user> operator access, enable HTTPS certificates, and choose Funnel or tailnet-only in the admin console. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
sudo tailscale set --operator=<user>
tailscale up
tailscale cert <tailnet-host>
```

Writes: `/var/lib/tailscale`

Check: tailscale status && tailscale cert <tailnet-host>

Hand back to the human: Install Tailscale, grant <user> operator access, enable HTTPS certificates, and choose Funnel or tailnet-only in the admin console.

### 1.4 Preview and install the host directories and user units, including the commit unit.

Command:

```sh
ops/bin/ogm-host-setup.sh --dry-run
ops/bin/ogm-host-setup.sh
```

Writes: `~/.config/systemd/user`, `~/.config/ogm`, `~/.local/share/ogm`, `~/.local/state/ogm`

Check: systemctl --user list-units 'ogm-*'

## 2. Install dependencies

Outcome: OGM, its workers, and its verification browser are built locally.

Time: ~30 min, mostly waiting

Preconditions: Step 1 is complete and the checkout is at ~/games/open-game-maker-2000.

### 2.1 Install Node 24 and pnpm 10.33.0, install and build the workspace, then restart the Node units onto the build.

Command:

```sh
corepack enable
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
systemctl --user restart ogm-api ogm-rooms ogm-games ogm-intake ogm-commit
```

Writes: `node_modules`, `apps/*/dist`, `packages/*/dist`, `services/*/dist`

Check: pnpm build

### 2.2 Install Elixir and Erlang through mise at ~/.local/bin/mise and build the voice-host release.

Command:

```sh
mise install
cd services/voice-host
mise exec -- mix deps.get
mise exec -- env MIX_ENV=prod mix release
```

Writes: `~/.local/bin/mise`, `services/voice-host/_build/prod/rel/voice_host`

Check: curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:40401/healthz after step 7

### 2.3 Build the Drive-sync and audio Python virtual environments.

Command:

```sh
make venv-drive-sync
make venv-audio
```

Writes: `scripts/py/drive-sync/.venv`, `scripts/py/audio/.venv`

Check: make test-py

### 2.4 Install ffmpeg, p7zip, git, curl, OpenSSL, unrar from non-free, and optional Blender with sudo. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
sudo apt install ffmpeg p7zip-full git curl openssl unrar
```

Writes: `/usr/bin/ffmpeg`, `/usr/bin/7z`

Check: ffmpeg -version && 7z

Hand back to the human: Install ffmpeg, p7zip, git, curl, OpenSSL, unrar from non-free, and optional Blender with sudo.

### 2.5 Install Chromium for Playwright, including its sudo-managed system dependencies once. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
pnpm --dir apps/web exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
```

Writes: `~/.cache/ms-playwright`

Check: pnpm --dir apps/web run e2e -- --list

Hand back to the human: Install Chromium for Playwright, including its sudo-managed system dependencies once.

### 2.6 Install the Codex CLI and Claude Code through their official installers and complete their subscription logins without API keys. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
codex --version
claude --version
```

Writes: `~/.codex`, `~/.claude`

Check: codex --version && claude --version

Hand back to the human: Install the Codex CLI and Claude Code through their official installers and complete their subscription logins without API keys.

### 2.7 Generate each service env file, add the documented ports and roots, and copy the commit env example without printing secrets.

Command:

```sh
pnpm --filter @ogm/config build
for unit in api rooms games voice-host intake backup drive-sync; do pnpm --filter @ogm/config exec ogm-env-init "$unit"; done
cp services/commit/ops/ogm-commit.env.example ~/.config/ogm/env/ogm-commit.env
# Fill OGM_API_PORT=4300, OGM_COMMIT_PORT=4301,
# OGM_ROOMS_PORT=4302, OGM_GAMES_PORT=<unused-loopback-port>,
# OGM_VOICE_PORT=40400, and OGM_VOICE_INTERNAL_PORT=40401.
# Fill OGM_DATA_DIR=~/.local/share/ogm/data,
# OGM_BLOB_ROOT=~/.local/share/ogm/blobs,
# OGM_GAMES_ROOT=~/.local/share/ogm/games,
# and OGM_ASSETS_ROOT=~/games/open-game-maker-2000/assets-local.
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/env`

Check: ops/bin/ogm-status

### 2.8 Seed the offline dependency store used by sandboxed builds.

Command:

```sh
bash scripts/sandbox/seed-store.sh
```

Writes: `~/.local/share/ogm/pnpm-store`

Check: bash scripts/sandbox/seed-store.sh prints the store size

## 3. Set up aiur for agent orchestration

Outcome: Aiur can run authenticated builder agents inside the OGM sandbox.

Time: ~40 min + two browser logins

Preconditions: Step 2 is complete and ~/.config/ogm/env/api.env exists.

### 3.1 Clone aiur-team/aiur to ~/github/aiur, build it from its README, and link the launcher OGM expects.

Command:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/aiur-team/aiur ~/github/aiur
# Follow ~/github/aiur/README.md, then link its built aiur executable:
ln -sfn ~/github/aiur/scripts/aiurdev ~/.local/bin/aiur
```

Writes: `~/github/aiur`, `~/.local/bin/aiur`

Check: aiur --help

### 3.2 After step 4 creates the builder machine user's PAT, return here to put it and a random Erlang cookie in ~/.aiur/.env with mode 0600. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
install -d -m 700 ~/.aiur
install -m 600 /dev/null ~/.aiur/.env
# Add GITHUB_TOKEN without printing it, then generate the cookie into the file:
cookie="$(openssl rand -hex 16)"
printf 'AIUR_ERLANG_COOKIE=%s\n' "$cookie" >> ~/.aiur/.env
unset cookie
```

Writes: `~/.aiur/.env`

Check: test "$(stat -c %a ~/.aiur/.env)" = 600

Hand back to the human: After step 4 creates the builder machine user's PAT, return here to put it and a random Erlang cookie in ~/.aiur/.env with mode 0600.

### 3.3 Run aiur login codex gamebuilder and aiur login claude default in a browser, then place the Codex login at ~/.config/ogm/codex-gamebuilder/auth.json. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
aiur login codex gamebuilder
aiur login claude default
install -d -m 700 ~/.config/ogm/codex-gamebuilder
# Link or copy the Codex login to ~/.config/ogm/codex-gamebuilder/auth.json.
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/codex-gamebuilder/auth.json`, `~/.config/aiur`

Check: aiur accounts && ls -l ~/.config/ogm/codex-gamebuilder/auth.json

Hand back to the human: Run aiur login codex gamebuilder and aiur login claude default in a browser, then place the Codex login at ~/.config/ogm/codex-gamebuilder/auth.json.

### 3.4 Run the sandbox probe and full offline proof.

Command:

```sh
bash scripts/sandbox/probe.sh
bash scripts/sandbox/proof/run.sh
```

Writes: `~/.local/share/ogm/pnpm-store`

Check: bash scripts/sandbox/proof/run.sh has no FAIL rows

### 3.5 Fill the aiur and builder fleet values in api.env; the fleet creates per-game daemon env files on the first job.

Command:

```sh
# Set AIUR_API_URL, AIUR_API_TOKEN, OGM_BUILDER_WORKSPACES_ROOT,
# OGM_BUILDER_BOT_TOKEN, and OGM_BUILDER_BOT_LOGIN in api.env.
systemctl --user restart ogm-api
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/env/api.env`, `~/.config/ogm/env/ogm-aiur@<slug>.env`

Check: systemctl --user list-units 'ogm-aiur@*' after the first build in step 8

### 3.6 Initialize aiur in an OGM fork that should accept agents on its own code, and optionally connect a Khala channel. (OPTIONAL)

Command:

```sh
aiur init
aiur --bg
```

Writes: `.aiur/config`

Check: aiur status

## 4. Set up the instance repository

Outcome: Builder and intake automation can update games and shared packages in one private instance repository, with the GitHub App installed on that repository only.

Time: ~30 min, mostly hand steps

Preconditions: Step 3 is complete and a GitHub owner is chosen.

### 4.1 Choose the GitHub account or free organization and create one private <github-owner>/<instance-repo> repository for this running Game Maker instance. Games live under games/<game-slug>/ and components shared by this instance's games live under packages/<name>/. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
# In GitHub, choose or create <github-owner>, then create one private <github-owner>/<instance-repo> repository.
```

Writes: `<github-owner>/<instance-repo>`

Check: <github-owner>/<instance-repo> is recorded in the instance environment for the remaining setup steps

Hand back to the human: Choose the GitHub account or free organization and create one private <github-owner>/<instance-repo> repository for this running Game Maker instance. Games live under games/<game-slug>/ and components shared by this instance's games live under packages/<name>/.

### 4.2 Create a free machine user with repo-and-issues access for intake and builder work, or use separate machine users if desired. Put only the selected tokens and logins in api.env and ~/.aiur/.env; one bot account may supply both roles. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
# Create one or two machine users and scoped PATs in GitHub.
# Set OGM_INTAKE_GITHUB_TOKEN, OGM_INTAKE_BOT_LOGIN,
# OGM_BUILDER_BOT_TOKEN, and OGM_BUILDER_BOT_LOGIN in api.env.
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/env/api.env`, `~/.aiur/.env`

Check: grep -E '^(OGM_INTAKE_BOT_LOGIN|OGM_BUILDER_BOT_LOGIN)=' ~/.config/ogm/env/api.env

Hand back to the human: Create a free machine user with repo-and-issues access for intake and builder work, or use separate machine users if desired. Put only the selected tokens and logins in api.env and ~/.aiur/.env; one bot account may supply both roles.

### 4.3 Create the GitHub App, grant the permissions the commit service uses, install it on <github-owner>/<instance-repo> only, and store its private key outside the repo. The App does not create repositories. Set its Setup URL to <app-origin>/connect/github with Redirect on update ticked, tick Request user authorization (OAuth) during installation so GitHub returns the code that proves which account a creator controls, put the App's client id and client secret in ogm-commit.env, and build the web app with VITE_GITHUB_APP_SLUG=<app-slug> so Connect GitHub opens the App installation. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
# Open https://github.com/settings/apps/new; Setup URL: <app-origin>/connect/github, tick Redirect on update and Request user authorization (OAuth) during installation; install the App only on <github-owner>/<instance-repo>.
# Copy the App's client id and client secret into GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_SECRET.
chmod 600 ~/.config/ogm/ogm-github-app.pem
systemctl --user restart ogm-commit
# Build apps/web with VITE_GITHUB_APP_SLUG=<app-slug> (the slug in https://github.com/apps/<app-slug>).
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/ogm-github-app.pem`, `~/.config/ogm/env/ogm-commit.env`

Check: journalctl --user -u ogm-commit -n 20 shows the App resolved an installation and no github-oauth-not-configured warning

Hand back to the human: Create the GitHub App, grant the permissions the commit service uses, install it on <github-owner>/<instance-repo> only, and store its private key outside the repo. The App does not create repositories. Set its Setup URL to <app-origin>/connect/github with Redirect on update ticked, tick Request user authorization (OAuth) during installation so GitHub returns the code that proves which account a creator controls, put the App's client id and client secret in ogm-commit.env, and build the web app with VITE_GITHUB_APP_SLUG=<app-slug> so Connect GitHub opens the App installation.

### 4.4 Put identical OGM_COMMIT_SERVICE_TOKEN and OGM_INTERNAL_TOKEN values in api.env and ogm-commit.env without printing them.

Command:

```sh
# Set matching shared tokens in ~/.config/ogm/env/api.env and ogm-commit.env.
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/env/api.env`, `~/.config/ogm/env/ogm-commit.env`

Check: grep -l '^OGM_INTERNAL_TOKEN=' ~/.config/ogm/env/*.env lists both files

## 5. Find assets

Outcome: A local, licensed asset catalog is searchable without committing private packs.

Time: ~20 min

Preconditions: Steps 1 and 2 are complete and OGM_ASSETS_ROOT points at assets-local/.

### 5.1 Create the gitignored asset-library layout with originals, extracted files, pack metadata, and a licence per version.

Command:

```sh
mkdir -p assets-local/packs/<vendor>-<pack>/<version>/{originals,extracted}
```

Writes: `assets-local/packs`

Check: test -d assets-local/packs && git check-ignore assets-local

### 5.2 Import free permissive packs first from Kenney, KayKit, itch.io, or Poly Pizza, and never run downloaded files.

Command:

```sh
python3 -I scripts/assets/import_kenney_bundle.py --help
pnpm --filter @ogm/gm-cli exec gm packs sync kaykit --dry-run
python3 -I scripts/assets/fetch_itch_free.py <page> <out>
python3 -I scripts/assets/fetch_polypizza_bundle.py --licenses CC0
```

Writes: `assets-local/packs`

Check: each imported pack contains pack.json and its licence file

### 5.3 Build the catalog and collection cards, search before choosing, and render thumbnails for candidate packs.

Command:

```sh
python3 -I scripts/assets/build_catalog.py
python3 -I scripts/assets/build_collection_cards.py
pnpm --filter @ogm/gm-cli exec gm assets search <words>
python3 -I scripts/assets/pack_thumbnails.py --help
```

Writes: `assets-local/catalog.json`, `assets-local/cards`

Check: your pack id appears in assets-local/catalog.json

### 5.4 Confirm every licence from the author's page and keep paid packs, keys, serials, download links, and all assets-local content off git and cloud models. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
pnpm --filter @ogm/gm-cli exec gm packs blocklist --help
```

Writes: `assets-local/pack-blocklist.json`

Check: git status --short contains nothing under assets-local/

Hand back to the human: Confirm every licence from the author's page and keep paid packs, keys, serials, download links, and all assets-local content off git and cloud models.

## 6. Local asset pipeline, optional Google Drive drop

Outcome: Local drops enter the intake queue, with an optional free Drive watch folder.

Time: ~30 min + optional Google console hand steps

Preconditions: Step 5 is complete and the intake env file points at the asset and state roots.

### 6.1 Configure and restart the intake worker so it de-duplicates drops and waits for human licence confirmation when required.

Command:

```sh
pnpm --filter @ogm/config exec ogm-env-init intake
systemctl --user restart ogm-intake
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/env/intake.env`, `~/.local/state/ogm/intake/status.json`

Check: cat ~/.local/state/ogm/intake/status.json

### 6.2 Optional Drive drop, all free with no billing account: in the Google Cloud console create a project, enable the Drive API, create the service account ogm-drive-sync, save its JSON key to ~/.config/ogm/drive-sa.json with mode 600, and share a Drive folder with its email as Viewer. (HAND)

Command:

```sh

chmod 600 ~/.config/ogm/drive-sa.json
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/drive-sa.json`

Check: stat -c %a ~/.config/ogm/drive-sa.json prints 600

```sh
sed -i 's/PASTE_FOLDER_ID_HERE/<folder-id>/' ~/.config/ogm/drive-sync.toml

scripts/py/drive-sync/.venv/bin/python -I scripts/py/drive-sync/drive_sync.py run --once --dry-run
systemctl --user restart ogm-drive-sync
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/drive-sync.toml`, `scripts/py/drive-sync/.venv`

Check: the dry run logs watching '<folder>' as <email>, and systemctl --user status ogm-drive-sync no longer prints PLACEHOLDER

## 7. Configure

Outcome: Origins, ingress, sign-in, budgets, and backups are configured for the host.

Time: ~30 min + hand steps

Preconditions: Steps 1 through 6 are complete and all selected env files exist.

### 7.1 Set public, games, app, and voice origins everywhere the shared env template names them.

Command:

```sh
# Set OGM_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://<tailnet-host>:8443
# Set OGM_GAMES_ORIGIN=https://<tailnet-host>:10000
# Set OGM_APP_ORIGIN=<app-origin> and OGM_VOICE_WS_URL in the named env files.
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/env`

Check: grep -l '^OGM_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=' ~/.config/ogm/env/*.env

### 7.2 Preview and configure Tailscale ingress with Funnel or tailnet-only access.

Command:

```sh
ops/bin/ogm-ingress.sh --dry-run
ops/bin/ogm-ingress.sh
# Use --tailnet-only instead of the second command when chosen in step 1.
```

Writes: `~/.config/ogm/tls`

Check: curl --fail https://<tailnet-host>:8443/healthz from a phone off Wi-Fi

### 7.3 Create the free Netlify app site for this instance on its own subdomain or domain, record its site id, set the app, games and API origins, include the host library assets its screens use, build the town, and approve the manual deployment. (HAND)

Command:

```sh
# Write the Netlify site id to apps/web/.netlify-site-id.
pnpm --filter @ogm/config exec ogm-env-init web
# Set OGM_PUBLIC_APP_ORIGIN=<app-origin> in web.env; each instance uses its own subdomain or domain.
# OGM_INSTANCE_ALL_ASSETS=1 is the generated instance default; licensed files stay gitignored and are staged only for this deploy.
# Set VITE_GAMES_ORIGIN=https://<tailnet-host>:10000 in web.env; deploy.sh bakes it in and refuses without it.
# Set VITE_API_ORIGIN=https://<tailnet-host>:8443 in web.env; deploy.sh writes _redirects from it.
# Optional: export OGM_DEPLOY_LOAD_SECONDS=<seconds> to override the 240-second title readiness window.
# Set OGM_APP_ORIGIN=<app-origin> in games.env so the games host allows the app as a frame ancestor.
apps/web/tools/town.sh
apps/web/tools/deploy.sh --dry-run
apps/web/tools/deploy.sh
```
